description: Dispositifs de séparation du trafic is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Shom. The product ‘Traffic Separation Devices’ contains a description of the TSDs in French maritime areas. A DST is a traffic organisation system aimed at separating opposing traffic flows by appropriate means, including the establishment of traffic corridors. Coverage: Shom. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic separation devices" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Shom. Its keywords include traffic-separation-schemes, dwrtpt, dst, produit, tssbnd, tsezne. The listing shows 6 download or service links in 0-HTTP--LINK, WFS. The listing shows 2021-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
